bio: Nestled in a small town at an elevation of 770m, this third-generation family business serves classic seasonal fare with a Mediterranean twist in an elegant light-filled extension. There are two set menus (one of them vegetarian), from which you can also order à la carte. Tempting dishes include Sigigen trout fillet with wild garlic, and timeless favourites such as Suure Mocke (marinated beef roast). Or why not share the Chateaubriand beef fillet for two? Friendly service. For a more rustic dining experience, head to Beizli & Sonnsyte, which also doubles as a lounge. Another option is to dine on the gorgeous terrace, where you can order from either restaurant....
